question.prompt: What is the maximum value of \(y=2\sin x\)?

solutions.explanation: \(A=2>0\), so the maximum value is the amplitude, \(2\).
solutions.title: Read the amplitude

solutions.explanation: The sine function never exceeds \(1\), so \(2\sin x\le2\) for every real \(x\). At \(x=\pi/2\), \(\sin x=1\), so this bound is attained. Therefore the maximum value is \(2\).
solutions.title: Bound the sine and attain the bound
